title: What Happens If You Swallow Chewing Gum?
description:
Send this to the friend who still believes swallowed gum stays seven years.
Gum base is mostly synthetic and your body has no enzyme for it, so it travels through whole, but it doesn't stick: Cleveland Clinic says it comes out in your stool about 40 hours later. One piece is very unlikely to hurt you. Rare blockages have been reported after swallowing lots of gum over and over, mostly in young kids. If someone swallowed a lot and has belly pain, cramping, vomiting or can't poop, see a doctor.
